title: Pip the Baby Dragon and the Sleepy Star
moral_lesson: Even when things feel lost, friendship and a gentle song can bring back the light.

characters.name: Pip the Baby Dragon
characters.visual_anchor: Pip the tiny purple and orange baby dragon, oversized glossy indigo wings, big sparkling violet eyes, gentle friendly snout, tiny soft horns, 3D Disney Pixar animation style, warm golden rim lighting, adorable miniature proportions

characters.name: Fern the Forest Fairy
characters.visual_anchor: Fern the Forest Fairy, flower petal dress, gossamer dragonfly wings with sparkle dust, emerald eyes, glowing green aura, 3D Disney Pixar animation style, warm golden rim lighting, delicate and sweet

frames.speaker: Pip the Baby Dragon
frames.dialogue: Pip can't sleep without his little star.
frames.visual_prompt: Pip the tiny purple and orange baby dragon, oversized glossy indigo wings, big sparkling violet eyes, gentle friendly snout, tiny soft horns, sitting on a cozy mossy bed inside a cave, looking up at an empty dark sky through cave opening, 3D Disney Pixar animation, soft moonlight, 8k

frames.speaker: Fern the Forest Fairy
frames.dialogue: Fern whispers, we'll find your star together.
frames.visual_prompt: Fern the Forest Fairy, flower petal dress, gossamer dragonfly wings with sparkle dust, emerald eyes, glowing green aura, standing beside Pip's cave entrance, gently holding Pip's claw, 3D Disney Pixar animation, enchanted forest moonlight, 8k

frames.speaker: Pip the Baby Dragon

frames.speaker: Pip the Baby Dragon

frames.dialogue: Fern adds sparkles to the sleepy star.
